subject: NovaAI trial readiness: access checklist & responsibilities
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Smith <elena@novaai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: NovaAI trial readiness: access checklist & responsibilities

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your trial started without friction.

Recap (from discovery):
- Goal: Validate developer integration and steady-state cost at ~100 concurrent requests and 8k token average context. Primary success criteria: latency P95 < 350ms, model output quality on 400 prompt set >= 0.85 (pass/fail tests), and cost under your internal target (~$0.40 per 1k tokens after optimizations).
- Timeline: suggested 2-week trial window starting with a kickoff and smoke tests.
- Integrations: initial calls via API + SDK, optional SSO for product team, and IP allowlist for network-restricted endpoints.

What we need from NovaAI to provision access this week:
1) IP ranges (CIDR) that need to be whitelisted on our side.
2) Names + emails for the engineers who need SSO invites (we can support Okta/GSuite SSO).
3) Any PO/contract redlines to get temp keys out (if procurement is required).

What Redwood will provide by kickoff:
- Temporary API key (scoped to a trial project) + usage caps.
- A lightweight trial success playbook (attached) with test prompts and monitoring checklist.
- A point-of-contact for ops: Marissa (cc) will manage keys/onboarding; Ben (cc) will handle SSO and IP allowlist plumbing.

Proposed dates: Kickoff call the week of 2026-06-15, trial 2026-06-16 to 2026-06-30. If that works, please send the IP list + two SSO accounts and I’ll confirm org-level invite links.

Attachments: trial-success-playbook.pdf (sample tests, monitoring checklist)

Thanks — I’ll loop internal owners once we get the IP list.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.example.com
From: Elena Smith <elena@novaai.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: NovaAI IT <it@novaai.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 19:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NovaAI trial readiness: access checklist & responsibilities

Thanks, Tessa — that summary is perfect. A couple items from our side:

1) Success criteria (internal):
- Integration tests: 95% of sample prompts must produce non-empty structured outputs as defined in the attached spec.
- Latency: P95 <= 300ms on our test harness that runs 500 concurrent requests over 5 minutes.
- Cost: total estimated cost for 2 weeks should be under $6k.

2) Owners:
- Elena Smith (Product) — primary contact for success criteria and scheduling.
- Raj Patel <raj.patel@novaai.com> (Engineering) — owns IP allowlist and SSO acceptance.
- IT alias (it@novaai.com) will process any procurement emails.

3) IP ranges to allow (attached): nova_trial_ip_list.csv (these are NAT egress ranges from our test environment).

4) SSO: please invite these accounts for Okta SAML SSO:
- sara.jones@novaai.com
- raj.patel@novaai.com

5) We will accept a scoped temp API key for the trial. We don’t need a PO to start; we just need a trial agreement signature if you have a short terms doc.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 2026-06-15 @ 10:00 PT (works for our team).

Attaching: nova_trial_ip_list.csv

Best,
Elena
Elena Smith
VP, Product | NovaAI

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Elena's IP list and SSO requests. Quick assignments so we can turn this around before the proposed kickoff: 

- Marissa: please create a scoped trial project and generate a temporary API key limited to 200k tokens/day. Put the key in a secure notes doc and share the stub only (no raw key in thread). Attach the onboarding checklist and confirm any rate-limit defaults.
- Ben: coordinate SSO invites (Okta SAML) for the two engineers and confirm the ACS/EntityID we need from NovaAI. Apply the IP allowlist Elena attached to the trial endpoints.

Also confirm whether we should send a short trial terms doc for signature (will coordinate legal if needed).
